shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated short vertical strokes/marks near the top
justification: Both surfaces carry a horizontal band of repeated short strokes across the upper zone above the main figural imagery, and both use highly schematic, outline-based creature forms, but this is a generic device that any tradition could produce. A shows a single large anthropomorph with a wheel/cross-in-circle for a head and sinuous limbs, while B shows a stacked assembly of distinct animals (quadrupeds, a bird, a serpent-like form) in registers on a pillar, with no anthropomorph and no cross-in-circle motif.
